# Pull Request

Submit your changes for review.

## 📝 Summary

Briefly describe the changes introduced by this PR. Mention any related issues
using keywords (e.g., `Closes #123`).

## ✨ Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue — typo, broken link,
      etc.)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds content or functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would require re-building the
      paper)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Styling / formatting

## 🧪 How Has This Been Verified

- [ ] **PDF builds correctly:** Open `paper.pdf` or check the Draft PDF action
- [ ] **References compile:** All citations render properly in the PDF
- [ ] **Figures display:** All figures are present and legible
- [ ] **Manual read-through:** Read the paper end-to-end for typos and clarity

## 🏗️ Checklist

- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own writing.
- [ ] I have updated the paper.md (or subsections) consistently.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the figures / data files.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or compilation errors.

## 📷 Screenshots / Preview (if applicable)

If this is a visual change (figure, layout, etc.), add a screenshot here.
